notes.title: Geometry Shooter PRO is now officially LIVE!
notes.content: [h2][b]Geometry Shooter PRO is Out Now on Steam![/b][/h2][hr][/hr][p]Today is the day! Geometry Shooter PRO has officially launched on Steam! 🚀 Step into a colorful arcade world where reflexes, strategy, and precision all come together for fast-paced, addictive fun.[/p][p][/p][p]Your goal? Fire from a moving cannon at expanding geometric shapes like circles, squares, and triangles. Each shape shows how many hits it takes to destroy, so every shot matters. Land a hit, and a brand-new figure appears where your bullet stops, turning every round into a chain reaction of action and strategy![/p][p][/p][p]But the fun doesn’t stop at single player. Challenge your friends in a competitive versus mode, or team up in co-op mode to push your skills to the limit together. With vibrant graphics and playful sound effects, Geometry Shooter PRO delivers both the challenge and the charm of a classic arcade experience.[/p][p][/p][h2]Check out the brand-new Release Trailer[/h2][hr][/hr][previewyoutube="X0ycRMcpR7Q;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Whether you’re chasing high scores, improving your precision, or just looking for some quick and satisfying action, this game is made to keep you coming back for “one more round.” Arcade fans, shooter enthusiasts, and casual players alike will find something to enjoy.[/p][p][/p][h2]Features:[/h2][p]• Enjoy easy to understand, yet skill based gameplay[/p][p align="start"]• Have fun with other players in versus and co-op modes[/p][p align="start"]• Collect useful power-ups to help you in your struggles[/p][p align="start"]• Top your scores in the leaderboards[/p][p align="start"]• Admire hand-drawn graphics and cool sound effects [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Play now![/h2][hr][/hr][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195710/Geometry_Shooter_Pro/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
